product_one_liner.value: SiteVue AI uses mounted and wearable cameras with AI video analytics to turn frontline work into operational data—such as cycle times, bottlenecks, quality and safety insights—for manufacturers, food processors and other industrial operators.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its operational analytics and industry use; the funding announcement describes the camera hardware and target sectors.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has no pricing link. The manufacturing page mentions per-camera setup and subscription billing, but does not present a dedicated pricing page or specific prices: https://www.sitevue.ai/manufacturing.

named_customers.notes: These customer names and associated customer representatives appear on the homepage.

hq_location.notes: The announcement identifies Nashville, Tennessee, as the company’s headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The announcement says the company was founded in August 2025.

eng_blog.notes: No engineering or technical blog was found. The homepage and search results did not reveal a blog index; unknown because there is no blog to evaluate.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer show no public documentation or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says “Coming Soon” and contains no job postings, including no AI, ML or data-science roles.

model_provider.notes: No public statement naming a model or model provider was found in the company’s product pages, accessible blog or press pages, or searches for AI-provider disclosures.

compliance_certs.notes: No public security, trust or legal certification statement was located; the accessible homepage makes general privacy claims but does not name any of the specified certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $7.5 million seed round on August 6, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed round falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page contains no open roles or sales-representative/account-executive postings; it says the page is coming soon.

launched_6mo.notes: No dated product or major-feature launch announcement was verified. A public line-simulation page is present, but its displayed September 14, 2026 date is a production/session date, not an identified launch date: https://www.sitevue.ai/demos/line-simulation/index.html. The press page is marked “Coming Soon”: https://sitevue.ai/press.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company’s accessible pages and search results did not provide a sufficiently complete team roster or a verifiable dated C-level/VP join or departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No job postings, public docs or integrations page naming CRM or sales/marketing systems was found. The homepage says deployment requires no software integration, but it does not identify systems used.
